Tatum then came away with a steal on the ensuing inbounds pass, only to turn the ball back over as he raced up the court in transition with 3.8 seconds remaining.

posts.title: Martin looking like 'a different player' and a couple Mavericks know why
posts.author: Eddie Sefko
posts.summary: PHOENIX – Either Caleb Martin is making up for lost time or he was really good at sandbagging everybody last season.
facts: Ask any member of the basketball staff and they’ll say the same thing: Martin is a major reason why they are 11-7 and on a four-game winning streak.
Martin had a career-best five steals on Tuesday in the 120-101 win at Denver, when the Mavericks put the handcuffs on the Nuggets, one of the best offensive teams in the NBA.

After last year, when the losses piled up and he fought various injuries (back, heel, ankle and a nasty illness that caused an extended outage) and played only 58 games, this is a remarkable bounce-back season for Martin…
He’s averaging 6.6 points, but that’s not particularly important.
He’s also averaging 1.4 steals and hitting 52.2 percent of his three-pointers.
On the first two games of this trip, Martin has averaged 13 points, five rebounds, four assists and 4.5 steals.
Martin is averaging 22.5 minutes per game because he’s earned it.
It’s a big uptick from the 14.8 minutes he played in a limited role last year.
quotes: We love him being out there doing whatever he wants on the defensive end. Obviously, he’s guarding the best guards every night. We need his energy and he creates a lot of fast breaks.
He’s looked obviously like a different player for us this year. I’m so happy for Caleb and the start to the year he’s had.
I want to match up with everybody’s best player,
That’s half the reason I feel like I’m in the league. I take pride in that and try to set the tone as best as I can and try to give those (opposing) guys as tough a time as I can.
